primary_evidence_note: Acosta-Fernandez 2010 pp122-125. Fifteen wild larvae collected on fruits of Hirschfeldia incana at El Batan Gran Canaria, 9 parasitized, 1 died unknown, 5 pupated including 2 malformed pupae that later died; no confirmed adult emergence.

Lepiforum Gran Canaria Cruz Verde 966m photographed by Hildegard Stalder; egg plant explicitly Descurainia preauxiana and oviposition directly observed; not verified that the photographed larva subsequently fed on it.
Secondary curated database lists primary hostplant Hirschfeldia incana, corroborating the 2010 direct field report; do not double count as independent species.

Author reports finding many larvae of taxon tamadabae on still unidentified tussock-forming grass at Gran Canaria, Mirador de Tasartico; Hyparrhenia hirta was nearby but not recorded with larvae, therefore H. hirta must NOT be promoted to a host.
